notes.content:
Added

 Added a lot of tutorial sections.
 Benjy now walks to Ada's House.
 Tooltips are more visible.
 Players will no longer regenerate energy if they have no blood.
 Players will hear an audible "hungry" sound when below 10%.
 When hungry, Players will sniff out a blood trail from Travelers.
 New Forageable Creature: Azure Butterflies.
 Added reroll limit when Selecting Arriving Travelers.
 Various sound effect and ambience improvements.
 Town Sanity stat is displayed instead of Mana.

Changes
 Stunned Travelers will reduce "warning" radius to other Visitors.
 Lighting saturation is reduced in the first night.

Bug Fixes
 Rummaging minigame spawned items behind buildings.
